title: CamGeo Land Use and Land Cover — Cameroon
description: EXAMPLE FILE — placeholder links, for teaching and validation only. Annual land use and land cover (LULC) maps of 7 regions of Cameroon (Est, Sud, Adamaoua, Littoral, Ouest, Nord-Ouest, Sud-Ouest), produced from free satellite data (Sentinel-2, Landsat, Sentinel-1) with open, reproducible methods. Each item ships with a provenance manifest and an accuracy statement.
